description:
Packed GDN prefill from BF16 Q/K/V, FP32 log-decay and beta, and readonly BF16 initial state. Returns BF16 attention output and optional newly allocated FP32 final state; preserves caller-provided output alias. D=128, TP=1/2/4/8, value/key head ratios 2/3; H4/HV32 is an additional ABI geometry case. The fixed native route uses use_cp=False. Projection, convolution and output normalization are outside this boundary.

Production entry: vllm.model_executor.layers.mamba.gdn.qwen_gdn_linear_attn.ChunkGatedDeltaRule.forward_cuda; fixed source revision source-package-sha256:c32a62577479241658b09298291061011448250471f8c0525075afd4569a5c73.

Parameter domain: shape_range.json defines dynamic request ranges and correlated model/ABI constraints; shape_cases.json fixes 10 representative workloads, not the complete support domain. Ragged positive prefill lengths, at most 32 requests and 16384 total tokens. Q/K heads=16/TP; value/state heads=16*head_ratio/TP; state per slot is [value_heads,128,128]. No measured traffic weights are claimed. Existing GPU evidence covers only the unchanged fixed sample, not every point in this dynamic domain.

Input construction: State matrices retain [Hv,128,128] and production strides, offsets and shared backing. Normal carried states now come from 32 previous valid tokens with fixed layer A_log/bias and the declared GDN per-head or KDA per-channel decay recurrence, FP32 between stores and actual state dtype at checkpoints. Synthetic raw projections have channel/head gains and AR(1) coefficient .5. Conv history and the current request are contiguous windows of that same process; candidate checkpoint j and convolution accepted-prefix shift refer to the same past endpoint. This is generated history, not captured model data. Existing tiny/zero/saturation/cancellation cases retain their stress construction. Pool capacity and physical slot pattern are independent input parameters, not inferred from request count or candidate width. Slot0/null semantics and unused storage guards remain.

defined_outputs.outputs_and_state: Always tuple: new BF16 out[1,T,HV,128], new FP32 final_state[N,HV,V,K] or None if output_final_state=False. Initial state and every input backing readonly. Optional core_attn_out gets flattened output prefix; extra capacity untouched, returned out does not alias it.
